study: Spatial ranking and ordered consumer search
outside_assignment: One independent private draw per ranking-comparison pair; identical type and fee/friction schedule within the pair.
search_tie_rule: Stop when the continuation gain is zero.
terminal_tie_rule: Exit when the best transaction surplus is zero; otherwise select the earliest inspected seller among equal positive maxima.
continuous_reference: Independent continuous uniform prices on [20,120] and outside options on [49,51]. This is a separate reference model, not the implemented grid.
